## Adding/removing a resource

- [ ] Entry is under the correct section
- [ ] Entry is alphabetized within its section
- [ ] Format matches `[Resource Name](url) - Brief description.`
- [ ] Link works and isn't already listed elsewhere in the list
- [ ] Description is factual and one sentence

## Adding a new section

- [ ] Section doesn't overlap an existing one
- [ ] Section is added to the Contents list, and the anchor link works
- [ ] Section has at least one entry or a placeholder line

## Other changes

Briefly describe the change. No checklist needed.
